label: SC-48(1)
title: Dynamic Relocation of Sensors or Monitoring Capabilities

statement.prose: Dynamically relocate {{ insert: param, sc-48.01_odp.01 }} to {{ insert: param, sc-48.01_odp.02 }} under the following conditions or circumstances: {{ insert: param, sc-48.01_odp.03 }}.

params.label: sensors and monitoring capabilities
guidelines: sensors and monitoring capabilities to be dynamically relocated are defined;

params.label: locations
guidelines: locations to where sensors and monitoring capabilities are to be dynamically relocated are defined;

guidelines: conditions or circumstances for dynamically relocating sensors and monitoring capabilities are defined;
